paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark bands

ink.$description: Ink — Primary body text, heading text, hairline borders, link color — the near-black that carries 90% of all strokes

true-black.$description: True Black — Solid surface fills for dark bands, inverted text backgrounds, inverted footer

graphite.$description: Graphite — Elevated dark surface, input field fills on dark contexts

carbon.$description: Carbon — Card border on light surfaces, subtle structural dividers

ash.$description: Ash — Muted body text, secondary metadata, less-prominent captions

fog.$description: Fog — Light borders, low-emphasis dividers, placeholder text

mist.$description: Mist — Tinted light surface between pure white and true black bands

haze.$description: Haze — Subtle alt-row surface, hover wash, low-contrast card fill

plain.$description: All roles — display, headings, body, caption, nav, button. The single typeface carries the entire site. Weight contrast is limited (400 vs 500) so hierarchy comes from size and tracking, not boldness. The 52px display at -0.02em tracking is anti-display: it whispers instead of shouts. Line-heights under 1.1 on 32–52px create stacked, compressed blocks where headings read as solid slabs. Open features 'kern' and 'case' hint at a typeface with carefully spaced uppercase alternates — the 'case' feature likely gives access to stylistic capital forms.
